One Creator, whose Name is Truth: the Maker, all-pervading, without fear, without enmity, beyond time, unborn, self-existent — realised by the Guru's grace.

true now as well, Nanak, and true for ever to come. ॥1॥

not by silence — though I stay absorbed in unbroken trance — does the mind grow still;

though I had thousands, even hundreds of thousands of clever skills, not one goes along with me.

So how can we become truthful? How is the wall of falsehood torn down?

By walking in the Hukam of the Commander, Nanak — the way written from the very beginning. ॥1॥
ਹੁਕਮੀ. ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਕਾਰ; ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥

ਹੁਕਮੀ. ਹੋਵਨਿ ਜੀਅ; ਹੁਕਮਿ. ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥

ਇਕਨਾ. ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ; ਇਕਿ, ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ॥

ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੇ ਬੁਝੈ; ਤ ਹਉਮੈ. ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥

some sing of the Lord's beautiful virtues and glories;
some, through learning, sing of hard philosophy;

some sing: "The Creator fashions the body, then turns it to dust";
ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ; ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥
some sing: "Life is taken away, then given again";
some sing: "The Lord seems far away, and looks distant";

The Giver keeps giving; the receivers grow weary of receiving.

ਆਖਹਿ. ਮੰਗਹਿ, ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ; ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
We ask and beg, "Give, give!" — and the Giver gives.

Then what can we place before the Lord, so that the court comes into view?
ਮੁਹੌ. ਕਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ; ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
What words should we speak, so that hearing them the Lord will love us?
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ; ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
In the hours before dawn, remember the True Name and reflect on the Lord's greatness.
ਕਰਮੀ ਆਵੈ ਕਪੜਾ; ਨਦਰੀ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
By grace comes the robe of praise; by the Lord's gaze, release and the door.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
Nanak: in this way we come to know that the Eternal One is everywhere. ॥4॥
ਥਾਪਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ; ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
The Lord cannot be installed like an idol, nor made by anyone.
The Lord is wholly self-existent, untouched by Maya.
Whoever remembers the Lord receives honour.
Nanak: let us sing of the Lord, the treasure of virtues.
Let us sing and listen, and keep the Lord's love in our minds.
ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ; ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰਿ, ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Pain is driven out, and peace comes to live in the heart.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦੰ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਦੰ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Through the Guru come the Name and wisdom; through the Guru we see the Lord pervading all.
ਗੁਰੁ ਈਸਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ, ਬਰਮਾ ਗੁਰੁ; ਪਾਰਬਤੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
For us the Guru is Shiva, the Guru is Gorakh and Brahma, the Guru is Mother Parvati.
ਜੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਣਾ, ਆਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ; ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Even if I understood the Hukam, I could not describe it; it cannot be put into words.
O Guru, give me this one understanding:
ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ, ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਸੋ. ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
that I never forget the One who gives to all beings. ॥5॥

I would bathe at a tirath only if it pleased the Lord; if it does not, what does bathing gain me?
ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਰਠਿ. ਉਪਾਈ ਵੇਖਾ; ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ. ਕਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਈ ॥
In all the creation I see, no one gains anything without grace.
ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ, ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕ; ਜੇ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
If one teaching of the Guru is heard, the mind fills with jewels, gems and rubies.
O Guru, give me this one understanding:
ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ. ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਸੋ. ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
that I never forget the One who gives to all beings. ॥6॥

If a person lived through the four ages, and ten times longer still,
ਨਵਾ ਖੰਡਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ, ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥

if the Lord's gracious gaze does not fall on them, no one even asks after them.
ਕੀਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ. ਕੀਟੁ ਕਰਿ; ਦੋਸੀ. ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
They are counted as the lowest worm, and the Lord charges them as an offender.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੇ; ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ, ਗੁਣੁ ਦੇ ॥
Nanak: the Lord gives virtue to the virtueless, and virtue to the virtuous too.
ਤੇਹਾ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ; ਜਿ. ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇ ॥੭॥
No one else can be seen who could give them any virtue. ॥7॥

listening, they see the Lord in every continent, world and underworld;
Nanak: the devotees are ever in bloom;
listening, pain and sin are destroyed. ॥8॥

listening, even the wicked begin to praise the Lord;
listening, the secrets of the body and the way of union are understood;
listening, the Shastras, Smritis and Vedas are understood.
Nanak: the devotees are ever in bloom;
3: listening, pain and sin are destroyed. ॥9॥

listening is bathing at the sixty-eight tiraths;
listening wins the honour others gain by study upon study;
listening, the mind settles into poised meditation.
Nanak: the devotees are ever in bloom;
listening, pain and sin are destroyed. ॥10॥
Listening, one sounds the depths of the ocean of virtues;
listening, one attains the rank of Sheikh, Pir and king;
listening, even the blind find the way;
Nanak: the devotees are ever in bloom;
listening, pain and sin are destroyed. ॥11॥

though people sit together and reflect on the state of the believer.

known only to one who takes it to heart. ॥12॥

believing, one understands all the worlds;
believing, one takes no blows to the face;
ਮੰਨੈ; ਜਮ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
believing, one does not go with the messenger of death.
Such is the Name, untouched by Maya —
ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੩॥
known only to one who takes it to heart. ॥13॥
Believing, no obstacle blocks the path;
believing, one departs with honour and renown;
believing, one no longer wanders down sectarian roads;
believing, one is bound directly to dharma.
Such is the Name, untouched by Maya —
ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
known only to one who takes it to heart. ॥14॥
Believing, one finds the door of release;
believing, one gives the family the Lord's support;
believing, the Guru crosses over and carries the Sikhs across;
believing, Nanak, one does not wander begging.

ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੫॥
known only to one who takes it to heart. ॥15॥
The chosen ones are accepted; the chosen ones lead.

the chosen ones keep their minds on the one Guru.

the Creator's creation cannot be counted.

Think how great a load rests on that bull!
There is more earth beyond this earth, and more and more beyond that;

Who knows how to write this account?
If it were written, how vast would it be?
How great the Lord's power, how beautiful the form!
How great the gifts — who can measure them?
With a single word the whole expanse was made,

What power do I have to reflect on it?
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥

You are forever secure, O Formless One. ॥16॥
Countless chant the Lord's Name; countless live in love;

countless are the charitable, countless the givers;
countless heroes take the blows of weapons face on;

I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
Whatever pleases You is the only good thing to do.
You are forever secure, O Formless One. ॥17॥

countless sinners sin and pass away;

Lowly Nanak offers only this reflection.
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
Whatever pleases You is the only good thing to do.
You are forever secure, O Formless One. ॥18॥

Through words comes the Name; through words, praise;
through words, wisdom and the songs of the Lord's virtues;
through words, destiny is written on the forehead.
ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
But the One who wrote them has no writing on the Lord's own forehead;
as the Lord commands, so beings receive.
All that is made is the Lord's own expression;
there is no place without the Lord.
What power do I have to reflect on the creation?
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥

You are forever secure, O Formless One. ॥19॥

When clothes are soiled with urine,

only love of the Name can wash it clean.

ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣਾ; ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਹੁ ॥

ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ; ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥

Victory to You! You are Maya, the Word and Brahma.

ਕਿਵ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਾ, ਕਿਵ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਕਿਉ ਵਰਨੀ. ਕਿਵ ਜਾਣਾ ॥

ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ; ਗਿਰਹਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
Kings and emperors with oceans of wealth and mountains of riches
ਕੀੜੀ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਨੀ; ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ, ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਹਿ ॥੨੩॥
are not equal to an ant that does not forget You. ॥23॥
ਅੰਤੁ ਨ. ਸਿਫਤੀ; ਕਹਣਿ. ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
There is no end to the Lord's praises, and no end to telling them;
ਅੰਤੁ ਨ. ਕਰਣੈ; ਦੇਣਿ. ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
no end to the Lord's works, and no end to the gifts;
ਅੰਤੁ ਨ. ਵੇਖਣਿ; ਸੁਣਣਿ. ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
no end to seeing, and no end to hearing.
ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ; ਕਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
No one can know the end of what is in the Lord's mind;
no one can know the end of the created world;
no one can see its near or far shore.
So many cry out to find the Lord's limits,
ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ; ਨ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
but those limits cannot be found.
The more is said, the greater the Lord appears.
Great is the Master, high the place;
higher still is the Lord's Name.
Only one as great and as high
How great the Lord is, the Lord alone knows.
Nanak: every gift comes from the Gracious One's gaze and grace. ॥24॥
The Lord's generosity is so great it cannot be written.
The Great Giver has not a trace of greed.
So many great warriors beg at the Lord's door;
so many others cannot be counted.
So many waste away in vice;
so many receive and then deny it;
so many fools just keep on eating;
so many endure pain, hunger and endless blows.
These too are Your gifts, O Giver.
Release from bondage comes through the Lord's will;
no one can name any other way.
If some fool presumes to name one,
only they will know how many blows they take to the face.
The Lord knows, and the Lord gives —
One blessed with the gift of the Lord's praise,
Nanak, is the king of kings. ॥25॥
Priceless are the virtues, priceless the trade in them;
priceless the traders, priceless the treasures;
priceless those who come for it, priceless what they take away;
priceless those in the Lord's love, priceless those merged in the Lord.
Priceless is the law, priceless the court;
priceless the scales, priceless the weights;
priceless the gifts, priceless their mark;
priceless the grace, priceless the command.
Priceless beyond price — it cannot be described.
Those who kept trying to describe it, absorbed in it, grew weary.
The Vedas and the Puranas describe the Lord;
the learned describe the Lord as they teach;
the Brahmas describe, the Indras describe;
6: the Gopis and the Krishnas describe;
the Shivas describe, the Siddhs describe;
the many Buddhas the Lord has made describe;
the demons describe, the gods describe;
ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ; ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵ ॥
the godlike people, the sages and the servants describe.
So many describe, and so many try to;
ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ; ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
so many have described again and again, and departed.
If You made as many again as You have already made,
ਤਾ. ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ; ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
even then they could not describe You.
The Lord becomes as great as the Lord wishes.
Nanak: the True One alone knows.
If some loose-tongued person claims to describe it,
they are written down as the greatest of fools. ॥26॥
ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ, ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ; ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
How wondrous is that door, that home, where You sit and care for all!
ਵਾਜੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ; ਕੇਤੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Countless instruments sound there, played by countless players;
ਕੇਤੇ. ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਨਿ; ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
so many raags with their raginis, so many singers!
ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਹਨੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ; ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
Air, water and fire sing of You; Dharamraj sings at Your door.
ਗਾਵਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ, ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Chitr and Gupt sing of You — who write the record for Dharamraj to judge.
ਗਾਵਹਿ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ; ਸੋਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Shiva, Brahma and the goddess, whom You adorn, sing of You.
ਗਾਵਹਿ ਇੰਦ, ਇਦਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ; ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Indra on his throne sings, with the gods at Your door.
ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਧ. ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
Siddhs in samadhi sing of You; the holy sing in contemplation.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ; ਗਾਵਹਿ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
The celibate, the generous and the content sing; the mighty warriors sing.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸਰ; ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
The Pandits and great rishis sing, age after age, with the Vedas.
ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ; ਸੁਰਗਾ ਮਛ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
Enchanting beauties sing, in heaven, on earth and in the underworld.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ; ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
The jewels You created sing, with the sixty-eight tiraths.
ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ; ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Mighty warriors and heroes sing; beings of all four sources of life sing.
ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਵਰਭੰਡਾ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
The continents, the worlds and the universes You made and hold in place sing.
ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ, ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ; ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
They alone truly sing of You who please You, Your devotees steeped in Your love.
ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਨਿ, ਸੇ. ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ; ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਕਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
So many others sing that I cannot bring them to mind; how can Nanak reflect on it all?
ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
That Lord alone is forever true, the true Master, with true glory.
ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ, ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ; ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
The Maker of creation is, and will be; the Lord was not born and will not pass away.
ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ, ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
The One who made Maya in so many colours, kinds and forms
ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ. ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ; ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
watches over what the Lord has made, as befits the Lord's greatness.
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ; ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
The Lord does whatever pleases; no one can give the Lord orders.
ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ. ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੨੭॥
The Lord is the King, the King of kings; Nanak: live within that will. ॥27॥
ਮੁੰਦਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ, ਸਰਮੁ ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ; ਧਿਆਨ ਕੀ. ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ॥
Make contentment your earrings, effort your begging bowl and bag, and meditation your ashes;
ਖਿੰਥਾ, ਕਾਲੁ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ; ਜੁਗਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
make the awareness of death your patched coat, a chaste body your discipline, and faith your staff.
ਆਈ ਪੰਥੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਮਾਤੀ; ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤੈ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੁ ॥
Make all humanity your order; conquer the mind, and you conquer the world.
I bow to the Lord, I bow to the Lord alone:
ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ. ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ; ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੮॥
the Primal One, the Pure, without beginning, beyond death, the same through every age. ॥28॥
ਭੁਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ, ਦਇਆ ਭੰਡਾਰਣਿ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਾਦ ॥
Make wisdom your food and compassion its server; hear the music that sounds in every heart.
ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ, ਨਾਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ; ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਾਦ ॥
The Lord is the Master, who holds all creation; miracles and powers are distractions.
ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਦੁਇ, ਕਾਰ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ; ਲੇਖੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਭਾਗ ॥
Union and separation together run the world; each receives their share as written.
7: I bow to the Lord, I bow to the Lord alone:
ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ. ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ; ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੯॥
the Primal One, the Pure, without beginning, beyond death, the same through every age. ॥29॥
ਏਕਾ ਮਾਈ. ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਿਆਈ; ਤਿਨਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
People say one mother, by some means, gave birth to three approved disciples:
ਇਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ. ਇਕੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ; ਇਕੁ ਲਾਏ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
one the creator, one the provider, one who holds court and destroys.
ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ; ਜਿਵ ਹੋਵੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
But the Lord runs everything as it pleases the Lord, by the Lord's own command.
ਓਹੁ ਵੇਖੈ, ਓਨਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ॥
The Lord watches them, yet they do not see the Lord — this is the great wonder.
I bow to the Lord, I bow to the Lord alone:
ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ. ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ; ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੦॥
the Primal One, the Pure, without beginning, beyond death, the same through every age. ॥30॥
The Lord's seat and storehouses are in every world.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੁ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰ ॥
Whatever was put in them was put in once and for all.
The Creator makes the creation and watches over it.
Nanak: true is the work of the True One.
I bow to the Lord, I bow to the Lord alone:
ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ. ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ; ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੧॥
the Primal One, the Pure, without beginning, beyond death, the same through every age. ॥31॥
ਇਕ ਦੂ ਜੀਭੌ. ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ; ਲਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਵੀਸ ॥
If one tongue became a hundred thousand, and those became two million,
ਲਖੁ ਲਖੁ ਗੇੜਾ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ; ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
and each repeated the one Name of the Lord of the world hundreds of thousands of times —
ਏਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ, ਪਤਿ ਪਵੜੀਆ; ਚੜੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਸ ॥
on this path, the steps to the Lord are climbed only by losing the self.
ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਆਕਾਸ ਕੀ; ਕੀਟਾ ਆਈ ਰੀਸ ॥
Hearing talk of the heavens, even worms want to imitate it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕੂੜੀ. ਕੂੜੈ ਠੀਸ ॥੩੨॥
Nanak: the Lord is found by grace; all else is the false boasting of the false. ॥32॥
No power to speak, no power to stay silent;
ਜੋਰੁ ਨ. ਮੰਗਣਿ; ਦੇਣਿ. ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
no power to beg, no power to give;
ਜੋਰੁ ਨ. ਜੀਵਣਿ; ਮਰਣਿ. ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
no power to live, no power to die;
ਜੋਰੁ ਨ. ਰਾਜਿ ਮਾਲਿ; ਮਨਿ ਸੋਰੁ ॥
no power to win the rule and wealth that set the mind clamouring;
no power to gain awareness, wisdom or reflection;
no power to find the way that frees one from the world.
ਜਿਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਜੋਰੁ; ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
The One who holds the power makes and watches over all.
Nanak: no one is high or low by their own doing. ॥33॥
Nights, seasons, lunar days and weekdays,
air, water, fire and the underworlds —
ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ, ਧਰਤੀ ਥਾਪਿ ਰਖੀ; ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ॥
among these the Lord set the earth as a place for practising dharma.
ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ; ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
On it live beings of every kind and way of life,
Each is judged by their own deeds.
True is the Lord, and true the court.
There the chosen ones shine, accepted,
and by the Gracious One's gaze they receive the mark of honour.
The raw and the ripe are sorted there;
Nanak: going there, it becomes clear. ॥34॥
This is the way of the Realm of Dharma.
Now hear of the working of the Realm of Wisdom.
ਕੇਤੇ ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਵੈਸੰਤਰ; ਕੇਤੇ ਕਾਨ ਮਹੇਸ ॥
So many airs, waters and fires; so many Krishnas and Shivas;
ਕੇਤੇ ਬਰਮੇ ਘਾੜਤਿ ਘੜੀਅਹਿ; ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇ ਵੇਸ ॥
so many Brahmas fashioning forms, of so many shapes, colours and guises;
ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮੀ, ਮੇਰ ਕੇਤੇ; ਕੇਤੇ ਧੂ, ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
so many earths, so many Meru mountains, so many Dhrus and their teachings;
ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ ਚੰਦ, ਸੂਰ ਕੇਤੇ; ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਦੇਸ ॥
so many Indras, moons and suns, so many worlds and lands;
ਕੇਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ, ਨਾਥ ਕੇਤੇ; ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵੀ ਵੇਸ ॥
so many Siddhs, Buddhas and Naths, so many forms of the goddess;
ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ, ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ; ਕੇਤੇ ਰਤਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ ॥
so many gods and demons, so many sages, so many jewels and oceans;
ਕੇਤੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ, ਕੇਤੀਆ ਬਾਣੀ; ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਤ ਨਰਿੰਦ ॥
so many sources of life, so many tongues, so many kings and rulers;
ਕੇਤੀਆ ਸੁਰਤੀ. ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇਤੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੩੫॥
so many ways of meditation, so many servants; Nanak, there is no end to the end. ॥35॥
In the Realm of Wisdom, wisdom reigns supreme;
there, it is like the joy of music, spectacle and delight.
8: In the Realm of Effort, the language is beauty;
there the mind is shaped into something beyond compare.
ਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ; ਕਥੀਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
What happens there cannot be told;
whoever tries to tell it regrets it afterwards.
ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
There awareness, understanding, mind and intellect are shaped;
ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ; ਸੁਰਾ ਸਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥੩੬॥
there the insight of gods and Siddhs is formed. ॥36॥
In the Realm of Grace, the language is strength;
there, nothing else exists but the Lord.
There dwell warriors, the mighty and the brave,
filled through and through with the Lord.
There, minds are woven wholly into the Lord's glory;
ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ; ਨ ਕਥਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
ਨਾ ਓਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ; ਨ ਠਾਗੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
They do not die, nor are they deceived,
ਜਿਨ ਕੈ; ਰਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
those in whose minds the Lord dwells.
Devotees of many worlds live there;
they rejoice, the True One in their minds.
In the Realm of Truth, the Formless One dwells,
who creates, and watches over creation with a gracious gaze.
There are continents, worlds and universes —
ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਥੈ; ਤ. ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤ ॥
if anyone tried to describe them, there would be no end.
There are worlds upon worlds and forms upon forms;
ਜਿਵ ਜਿਵ ਹੁਕਮੁ; ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਕਾਰ ॥
as the Hukam is, so they act.
The Lord watches, reflects and rejoices.
Nanak: describing this is as hard as steel. ॥37॥
Let self-restraint be the furnace and patience the goldsmith;
let understanding be the anvil and wisdom the hammer;
let the fear of the Lord be the bellows and disciplined effort the fire;
let love be the crucible, and melt the Lord's amrit Name in it.
In this true mint the Shabad is forged.
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ; ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰ ॥
This is the work of those on whom the gaze of grace falls.
Nanak: the Gracious One's glance brings them joy. ॥38॥
ਪਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ, ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ; ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
Air is the Guru, water the father, and the earth the great mother.
ਦਿਵਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ, ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ; ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
Day and night are the two nurses in whose care the whole world plays.
Good and bad deeds are read out in the presence of Dharamraj.
ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ; ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
By their own deeds, some are drawn near and some pushed far away.
ਜਿਨੀ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥
Those who meditated on the Name have made their labour count.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ; ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Nanak: their faces shine, and many others are freed along with them. ॥1॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ, ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ; ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
What a door, what a home is Yours, where You sit and care for all!
ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ; ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Countless instruments play for You, countless players play them;
ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ, ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ; ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
so many raags with their raginis, so many singers sing to You.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ; ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
Air, water and fire sing of You; Dharamraj sings at Your door.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ; ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Chitr and Gupt sing of You — who write the record for Dharamraj to judge.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ; ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Shiva, Brahma and the goddess sing of You, ever adorned by You.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ. ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ; ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Indra on his throne sings of You, with the gods at Your door.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Siddhs in samadhi sing of You; the holy sing of You in contemplation.
9: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ; ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
The celibate, the generous and the content sing of You; the mighty warriors sing of You.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ, ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ; ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
The Pandits and great rishis sing of You, age after age, with the Vedas.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ; ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
Enchanting beauties sing of You, in heaven, on earth and in the underworld.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ, ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ; ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
The jewels You created sing of You, with the sixty-eight tiraths.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ; ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Mighty warriors and heroes sing of You; beings of all four sources of life sing of You.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
The continents, worlds and universes You made and hold in place sing of You.
ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ, ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ; ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
They alone truly sing of You who please You, Your devotees steeped in Your love.
ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ, ਸੇ. ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ; ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਕਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
So many others sing of You that I cannot bring them to mind; how can Nanak reflect on it all?
ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
That Lord alone is forever true, the true Master, with true glory.
ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ, ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ; ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
The Maker of creation is, and will be; the Lord was not born and will not pass away.
ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ, ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
The One who made Maya in so many colours, kinds and forms
ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ. ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ; ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
watches over what the Lord has made, as befits the Lord's greatness.
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
The Lord does whatever pleases; no one can give the Lord orders.
ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
The Lord is the King, the King of kings; Nanak: live within that will. ॥1॥
Hearing others, everyone calls You great;
but how great You are is known only by seeing You.
Your worth cannot be measured or described;
those who describe You are absorbed in You. ॥1॥
ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ; ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
O my great Master, deep and unfathomable, ocean of virtues,
ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ; ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ, ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
no one knows how vast Your expanse is. ॥1॥ Rahao
All the meditators met and meditated;
all the appraisers met and tried to appraise You;
the wise, the contemplative, and the teachers of teachers —
ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
none could describe even a sesame seed of Your greatness. ॥2॥
ਸਭਿ ਸਤ. ਸਭਿ ਤਪ; ਸਭਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
All truth, all austerity, all goodness,
all the great powers of the Siddhs —
ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ; ਸਿਧੀ. ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
without You, no one has attained them.
They come by Your grace, and no one can hold them back. ॥3॥
What can the poor speaker say?
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ; ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
Whom You bless, no one can hinder;
Nanak: the True One sets them right. ॥4॥2॥
Remembering the Name, I live; forgetting it, I die.
It is hard to remember the True Name.
When hunger for the True Name comes,
that hunger eats away all pain. ॥1॥
How could I forget that Lord, my mother?
True is the Master, found through the True Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
Even a sesame seed of the True Name's greatness —
people have tired of describing it, and could not measure it.
ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ; ਆਖਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
If everyone joined together to describe it,
ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
the Lord would grow no greater, nor any less. ॥2॥
ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
The Lord does not die; there is no mourning.
The Lord keeps giving, and the gifts never run out.
This is the Lord's greatness: there is no other.
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
There has never been one, nor ever will be. ॥3॥
As great as You are, so great are Your gifts.
10: ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ; ਕੀਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
You made the day, and made the night.
Those who forget the Master are low.
Nanak: without the Name, they are outcasts. ॥4॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਪੁਰਖਾ; ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
O servant of the Lord, True Guru, True Being, I make this prayer to you, O Guru:
ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ. ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
I am a lowly worm; True Guru, I seek your shelter — be kind and light up the Name in me. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ; ਮੋ ਕਉ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
O my friend, divine Guru, light up the Lord's Name in me.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ, ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Name, through the Guru's teaching, is the companion of my life; the Lord's praise is my provision for the road. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ, ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
Great is the fortune of the Lord's servants who have faith in the Lord and thirst for the Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ, ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਹਿ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Receiving the Lord's Name they are satisfied; in the company of the holy, their virtues shine. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ, ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Those who have not tasted the essence of the Lord's Name are unfortunate, caught by death.
ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਆਏ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵੇ. ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Those who have not come to the True Guru's shelter and company — cursed is their life, cursed their living. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ; ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਾਸਿ ॥
The Lord's servants who have found the True Guru's company had it written on their foreheads from the start.
ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ, ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
Blessed, blessed is the true company, where the Lord's essence is found; meeting it, Nanak, the Name shines. ॥4॥4॥
ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ, ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ; ਜਾ ਆਹਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
Why, O mind, do you plot and scheme, when the Lord is already taking care of you?
ਸੈਲ ਪਥਰ ਮਹਿ. ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ, ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
The Lord created beings in rocks and stones, and set their food before them. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ. ਸੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
O my Lord, whoever joins the true company is saved.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace the supreme state is reached, and dry wood turns green. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਨਨਿ ਪਿਤਾ, ਲੋਕ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ; ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
Mother, father, people, children, spouse — no one is anyone's support.
ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਭਉ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
The Master provides food for each and every one; why are you afraid, O mind? ॥2॥
ਊਡੇ ਊਡਿ. ਆਵੈ ਸੈ ਕੋਸਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਬਚਰੇ ਛਰਿਆ ॥
The crane flies hundreds of miles, leaving her young behind;
ਤਿਨ ਕਵਣੁ ਖਲਾਵੈ, ਕਵਣੁ ਚੁਗਾਵੈ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ. ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
who feeds them, who gives them food? She keeps them in her mind. ॥3॥
ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ. ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਨ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
All treasures and the eighteen spiritual powers are held in the palm of the Master's hand.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ, ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ; ਤੇਰਾ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You; Your limits have no near or far shore. ॥4॥5॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ, ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
That Being is pure — the Lord, the pure Being, unreachable, unfathomable, infinite.
ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
All meditate, all meditate on You, O true Lord, Creator of all.
ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀ; ਤੂੰ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
All beings are Yours; You are the Giver to all beings.
ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ; ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Meditate on the Lord, O saints, who takes away all sorrow.
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ, ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੀ; ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
The Lord is the Master, the Lord is the servant; Nanak: what are poor creatures on their own? ॥1॥
